What are my driver protection plan options?

While safety is our top priority and our instructors are with you every step of the way, incidents can happen. To help cover costs in the event of an accident, we offer three levels of driver protection plans:

- Base Level: $39 ($20,000 coverage / $6,000 deductible)

What are the height/weight requirements?

The weight limit for all of the supercars is 350lbs. Each car has a different cabin space and a helmet adds a couple inches. Our cars are straight off the line, so the max height limits are:

**What “zrx1” is:** There is no production Chevrolet “Corvette ZRX1.” Official name is **Corvette ZR1X** (Chevy’s pinnacle). Chevy: [lineup / pinnacle](https://www.chevrolet.com/performance/corvette#pinnacle) and [ZR1X page](https://www.chevrolet.com/performance/corvette/zr1x). “ZRX1” is a ZR1X typo (e.g. 365Daily gallery captions). ZR1X is a **street-legal** 2026/2027 hybrid eAWD hypercar: LT7 twin-turbo 5.5L V8 (1,064 hp) + front electric motor (186 hp) = **1,250 combined hp**, 1.89 s 0–60, 8.99 s ¼-mile, from **$227,500**. First customer cars landed Feb 2026 (e.g. Stonebrier Chevy; NCM R8C delivery mid-March 2026). It is not track-only.

**ZR1X public drive / rental / track — none confirmed**
- **Ron Fellows / Spring Mountain (Pahrump, NV):** Chevy confirmed a **ZR1X-only 2-day owners class** included with purchase ([CorvetteForum article, Chevy PR correction 3/25/26](https://www.corvetteforum.com/articles/ron-fellows-driving-school-wont-offer-a-dedicated-corvette-zr1x-class/)). **Owners only, not public.** As of **Jul 7, 2026**, school staff told an owner they had **zero ZR1X cars**, waiting on allotment + break-in ([forum thread](https://www.corvetteforum.com/forums/c8-zr1-zr1x-discussion/5000423-spring-mountain-for-zr1x-owners.html)). Public calendar lists ZR1 / Z06 / Stingray / E-Ray schools, **not ZR1X**: [calendar](https://calendar.springmountainmotorsports.com/), [school page](https://www.springmountainmotorsports.com/driving-schools/ron-fellows-performance-driving-school/).

Circuit Florida (Auburndale): **Dec 17–20 2026**, then 2027 — **no Oct dates** ([official track page](https://www.thextremexperience.com/tracks/circuit-florida)). Z06 from ~$299–$389 + $39–$129 driver protection.

- Hertz/Sixt Miami luxury pages do **not** list ZR1X.
